subject: Getting coefficients from models fit with dplyr do()

messages.author: 71171f0d61fc140f
messages.subject: Getting coefficients from models fit with dplyr do()
parts:
On occasion, I've used plyr to fit multiple models, and extract their coefficients like so.

library(plyr)

models_plyr <- dlply(mtcars, .(cyl), with, lm(mpg ~ wt))
coefs_plyr <- ldply(models_plyr, coef)
 
#   cyl (Intercept)        wt
# 1   4    39.57120 -5.647025
# 2   6    28.40884 -2.780106
# 3   8    23.86803 -2.192438 

I'm curious whether there's a roughly equivalent way in dplyr 0.2.

library(dplyr)

models_dplyr <- mtcars %>% group_by(cyl)

Here are my attempts, and how they've failed.

coefs_dplyr <- models_dplyr %>% do(coef(lm))
# Error: object of type 'closure' is not subsettable 

coefs_dplyr <- models_dplyr %>% coef(.$lm)
is.null(coefs_dplyr)
# [1] TRUE 

coefs_dplyr <- models_dplyr %>% summarise(coefs = coef(lm))
# R encountered a fatal error (in RStudio)
 
coefs_dplyr <- models_dplyr %>% ddply(., .(cyl), with, coef(lm))
# data frame with 0 columns and 0 rows 

-Joe

parts:
Damn. Serves me right. Got exactly the same output as plyr with:

library(dplyr)
library(reshape2)

mtcars %>% 
  group_by(cyl) %>%
  do(mod = lm(mpg ~ disp, data = .)) %>%
  do(data.frame(var = names(coef(.$mod)),
                coef = coef(.$mod),
                cyl = .$cyl)) %>%
  dcast(., cyl~var, value.var = "coef")

dplyr hasn't subsumed dcast functionality at all, has it?

-Joe
